source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 14 exercise solved (PDF 23-24): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, comparison tables, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Farq wale sawalon ke jawab table mein hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which one of these is not a part of single nephron?
(In mein se kaun sa ek nephron ka hissa nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Nephron = renal corpuscle (glomerulus + Bowman's capsule) aur renal tubule (proximal tubule, loop of Henle, distal tubule). Kai nephrons ki distal tubules ek collecting duct mein girti hain, is liye yeh ek nephron ka hissa nahi (14.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. In a healthy person, glucose is present in blood but not in urine. This is because glucose molecules are;
(Sehatmand insaan ke khoon mein glucose hota hai magar peshab mein nahi, kyun ke glucose molecules:)

options.text: Proximal convoluted tubule se wapas khoon mein jazb ho jate hain
Kidneys mein oxidise ho jate hain
Kidneys mein jama ho jate hain
Bowman's capsule mein jane ke liye bohat bare hain

blocks.explanation: Glucose filter ho kar Bowman's capsule mein aata hai, magar proximal convoluted tubule se active transport ke zariye wapas khoon mein chala jata hai (14.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
3. The sizes of molecules present in Bowman's capsule are smaller than the sizes of molecules present in;
(Bowman's capsule ke molecules ka size kis ke molecules se chhota hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Afferent arteriole mein poora khoon hai jis mein plasma proteins aur blood cells hain jo filter hone ke liye bohat bare hain. Bowman's capsule ke filtrate mein, aur us ke baad tubule aur ducts mein, sirf chhote molecules hain (14.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
4. If a drug reduces mitochondrial activity in nephrons, which chemical will be present in increased amounts in the urine?
(Agar koi dawa nephrons mein mitochondria ka kaam kam kar de to peshab mein kaun si cheez zyada aayegi?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose active transport se wapas jazb hota hai jis ke liye mitochondria ka ATP chahiye. ATP kam ho to glucose filtrate mein reh kar peshab mein aa jata hai (14.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
5. The water content of blood is regulated by ADH. In which part of the nephron this regulation occurs?
(Khoon mein pani ki miqdaar ADH control karta hai. Yeh control nephron ke kis hisse mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: ADH collecting ducts ki deewaron par asar kar ke unhein pani ke liye zyada permeable banata hai, is liye zyada pani khoon mein wapas jata hai (hormonal control).

blocks.prompt:
6. In kidneys, glucose is reabsorbed into blood. Where does this reabsorption occur?
(Kidneys mein glucose khoon mein wapas jazb hota hai. Yeh kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar reabsorption proximal convoluted tubule mein hota hai; glucose, amino acids aur namak wahan active transport se khoon mein wapas jate hain (14.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
7. In normal conditions, which one is completely reabsorbed from renal tubule into blood?
(Normal halat mein renal tubule se kaun si cheez poori ki poori khoon mein wapas jazb hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sehatmand insaan mein filter hua sara glucose wapas jazb ho jata hai, is liye peshab mein nahi hota; kuch pani, namak aur zyada tar urea peshab mein jate hain (14.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
8. If the loops of Henle are absent in all nephrons, what would happen?
(Agar tamam nephrons mein loops of Henle na hon to kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Loop of Henle counter-current mechanism se medulla mein namak ki zyada concentration banata hai jo collecting duct se pani kheenchti hai. Is ke baghair kam pani jazb hoga aur peshab patla banega (14.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
9. In peritoneal dialysis, the lining of which part of the body acts as a filter?
(Peritoneal dialysis mein jism ke kis hisse ki andaruni jhilli filter ka kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peritoneal dialysis mein pet (abdominal cavity) ki andaruni jhilli peritoneum istemal hoti hai; is ki capillaries se fazle dialysate mein jate hain (14.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
10. During which of these treatments, the patients are prescribed immunosuppressant drugs?
(In mein se kis ilaj mein mareezon ko immunosuppressant dawaiyan di jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kidney transplant ke baad immunosuppressant dawaiyan di jati hain taake mareez ka immune system nayi kidney ko radd (reject) na kare (14.3.4).

blocks.prompt:
1. Justify the functioning of kidneys as both excretion and osmoregulation.
Sabit karein ke kidneys excretion aur osmoregulation dono ka kaam karti hain.
blocks.explanation:
Excretion: kidneys khoon se metabolic fazle (urea, faltu namak, faltu pani) chhaan (filter) kar peshab ki shakal mein nikalti hain.
Osmoregulation: reabsorption kam ya zyada kar ke pani aur namak ka tawazun rakhti hain: body fluids hypotonic hon to patla peshab, hypertonic (pani ki kami) hon to gaarha peshab; yeh ADH aur aldosterone ke control mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. List the organs of the urinary system.
Urinary system ke aaza (organs) ki fehrist banayein.
blocks.explanation: Do kidneys (peshab banati hain), do ureters (peshab ko bladder tak le jate hain), ek urinary bladder (peshab jama karta hai) aur ek urethra (peshab ko jism se bahar le jati hai).

blocks.prompt:
3. Define glomerular filtration.
Glomerular filtration ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Glomerular filtration (ultrafiltration) peshab banne ka pehla qadam hai: glomerulus mein khoon ka zyada pressure (efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai) pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak ko khoon se Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai. Khoon ke maaye hisse ka taqreeban 20% glomerular filtrate banta hai; plasma proteins aur blood cells khoon mein rehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Compare the function of glomerular capillaries and peritubular capillaries.
Glomerular capillaries aur peritubular capillaries ke kaam ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono capillary beds aage peechhe kaam karte hain: pehla filter karta hai, doosra wapas leta aur secrete karta hai.

rows: Bowman's capsule ke andar; afferent arteriole se
Renal tubules ke gird; efferent arteriole se
Filtration ke liye
Reabsorption aur secretion ke liye
Khoon ka pressure zyada
Pressure kam
Pani aur chhote solutes khoon se nephron mein dhakelte hain
Tubules se glucose, ions aur pani wapas lete hain; zehreele maadde tubule mein daalte hain

blocks.prompt:
5. What are the three main processes involved with urine formation?
Peshab banne ke teen bunyadi processes kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Glomerular filtration: khoon chhan kar Bowman's capsule mein aata hai.
2. Selective reabsorption: kaam ki cheezein tubule se peritubular capillaries mein wapas jati hain.
3. Tubular secretion: distal tubule khoon se H+, K+, ammonium, zehreele maadde aur dawaiyan filtrate mein daalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What are the causes of kidney failure?
Kidney failure ki wajoohaat kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
Chronic kidney failure: sugar ki beemari (diabetes), high blood pressure, kidney ki beemari (purana infection, glomeruli ki sozish).
Acute kidney failure: kidney ka infection, peshab ki naali mein rukawat (pathri, bladder cancer, bara hua prostate), NSAIDs jaisi dawaiyan, renal arteries ya arterioles mein khoon ke lothre (clots).

blocks.prompt:
7. Why do blood and dialysate flow in opposite direction?
Khoon aur dialysate ulti simt mein kyun behte hain?
blocks.explanation: Ulti simt mein bahao (counter-current) dialyzer ki poori membrane par concentration ka farq qaim rakhta hai: khoon har jagah kam fazle wale taaza dialysate se milta hai, is liye urea, namak aur pani musalsal khoon se bahar nikalte hain aur zyada fazla saaf hota hai (chapter se aage; chapter sirf dialyzer bayan karta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: agar dono ek hi simt mein bahein to thori door ke baad khoon aur dialysate mein fazle ki miqdaar barabar ho jayegi aur safai ruk jayegi. Ulti simt mein bahao se yeh farq aakhir tak bana rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between:
Afferent and efferent arterioles
Farq bataein: afferent aur efferent arterioles
blocks.explanation: Dono glomerulus ki arterioles hain: ek khoon andar laati hai, doosri bahar le jati hai.

rows: Renal artery ki shaakh; glomerulus mein khoon laati hai
Glomerulus se khoon bahar le jati hai
Chauri
Tang; glomerulus ka pressure zyada rakhti hai
Glomerular capillaries mein khulti hai
Peritubular capillaries (aur vasa recta) mein bat-ti hai

blocks.prompt:
8. Chronic and acute renal failure
Chronic aur acute renal failure
blocks.explanation: Dono mein kidney fazle chhanne aur pani-namak control karne ki salahiyat kho deti hai; farq shuru hone aur anjaam ka hai.

Achanak hoti hai (kidney injury)

Aksar ilaj se theek ho jati hai

Wajah: kidney infection, peshab ki rukawat, NSAIDs, renal naliyon mein clots

blocks.prompt:
8. Haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis
Haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis
blocks.explanation: Dono renal dialysis hain, yani kidney failure mein khoon se fazlon ko masnooi tareeqe se nikalna.

blocks.prompt:
8. Renal cortex and renal medulla
Renal cortex aur renal medulla
blocks.explanation: Yeh kidney ke bahar aur andar wale hisse hain.

Kidney ka andar wala hissa

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the structure of kidney and relate it with its function.
Kidney ki banawat bayan karein aur us ka kaam se taalluq bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: do kidneys pet ke oopri hisse mein, reerh ki haddi ke dono taraf, 12th thoracic aur 3rd lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan hain; daayan kidney jigar ki wajah se thora neeche aur chhota hai; 11th aur 12th pasliyan inhein kuch had tak bachati hain.
Bairooni banawat: surkhi mayal bhoora, lobiye (bean) jaisa, oopar adrenal gland; reshedar renal capsule mein band; ek ubhra (convex) aur ek andar ko daba (concave) kinara; concave taraf ka gadha hilum hai jahan se renal artery andar aati aur renal vein aur ureter bahar nikalte hain.
Andaruni banawat:
1. Renal cortex: bahar wala hissa, wazan ka taqreeban ek tihai.
2. Renal medulla: andar wala hissa, taqreeban do tihai, kone jaise renal pyramids se bana.
3. Renal pelvis: beech mein keep (funnel) jaisi jagah jo peshab jama kar ke ureter mein bhejti hai.
4. Nephrons: har kidney mein taqreeban das lakh, kaam ki ikaai; cortical (85%, chhote loops) aur juxtamedullary (lambe loops, medulla mein gehre).
Kaam se taalluq:
- Kidneys ko dil ke khoon ka 20-25% milta hai, is liye sara khoon din mein kai dafa chhanta hai.
- Cortex ke renal corpuscles khoon filter karte hain (tang efferent arteriole pressure zyada rakhti hai).
- Peritubular capillaries se ghiri tubules kaam ki cheezein wapas leti aur fazle daalti hain.
- Medulla ke loops of Henle aur collecting ducts medulla ko namkeen rakh kar peshab gaarha karte aur pani bachate hain (osmoregulation).
- Collecting ducts, pyramids aur pelvis peshab ko ureter, bladder aur urethra tak pohanchate hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the detailed structure of nephron.
Nephron ki tafseeli banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Har kidney mein taqreeban das lakh khurdbeeni nephrons hain jo kidney ki kaam ki ikaai hain. Nephron ke do bare hisse hain.
A. Renal corpuscle:
1. Glomerulus: afferent arteriole se bana capillaries ka jaal, jis se khoon ek tang efferent arteriole mein nikalta hai.
2. Bowman's capsule: pyale (cup) jaisi do deewaron wali thaili jo glomerulus ko gherti aur filtrate leti hai.
B. Renal tubule: Bowman's capsule se nikalti lambi naali, teen hisse:
1. Proximal convoluted tubule: pehla, bohat bal khaya (coiled) hissa; zyada tar reabsorption yahan.
2. Loop of Henle: U jaisa mor; descending limb medulla ki taraf, ascending limb wapas cortex ki taraf aa kar renal corpuscle ke paas.
3. Distal convoluted tubule: phir se bal khaya hissa; tubular secretion ki jagah.
Kai nephrons ki distal tubules ek collecting duct mein girti hain; collecting ducts mil kar papillary ducts banati hain jo renal pelvis mein khulti hain.
Khoon ki supply: efferent arteriole convoluted tubules ke gird peritubular capillaries banati hai, aur juxtamedullary nephrons mein vasa recta bhi (loops of Henle ke saath seedhi capillaries); yeh venules aur renal vein mein milti hain.
Qismein: cortical nephrons (taqreeban 85%, zyada tar cortex mein, chhote loops) aur juxtamedullary nephrons (cortex mein medulla ke qareeb se shuru, lambe loops medulla mein gehre tak).

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the main processes in kidney functioning.
Kidney ke kaam ke bunyadi processes bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kidneys khoon se fazle aur faltu pani chhaan kar peshab banati hain; nephron mein teen qadam hote hain.
1. Glomerular filtration (ultrafiltration): ek physical process. Efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus mein khoon ka pressure zyada hai. Pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak (Na+, K+, Cl-) Bowman's capsule mein dhakele jate hain; khoon ke maaye hisse ka taqreeban 20% glomerular filtrate banta hai. Plasma proteins (albumin, globulins) aur blood cells bare hain, khoon mein rehte hain.
2. Selective reabsorption: kaam ki cheezein tubule se peritubular capillaries mein wapas.
- Proximal tubule: zyada tar reabsorption; taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se; glucose, amino acids aur namak (Na, K, Ca) active transport se.
- Loop ka descending limb: mazeed pani wapas.
- Ascending limb: pani nahi guzarta; namak active tor par bahar pump hota hai.
- Distal tubule: kuch pani aur namak.
- Collecting duct: pani ke reabsorption ki aakhri jagah (ADH ke control mein).
3. Tubular secretion: reabsorption ka ulat. Distal tubule ke cells khoon se H+, ammonium, K+, zehreele maadde aur dawaon ke bachay hisse (maslan penicillin) le kar filtrate mein daalte hain; H+ ke ikhraj se khoon ka pH barqarar rehta hai.
Ikhraj: peshab collecting ducts se renal pelvis, ureter aur bladder mein aur urethra se bahar; jawan aadmi din mein 1-2 litre (zyada peene se zyada; namkeen khana, warzish ya garmi mein kam).
Kidneys patla ya gaarha peshab bana kar osmoregulation bhi karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Explain that concentration of urine is regulated by counter-curent and hormonal mechanisms.
Bayan karein ke peshab ki concentration counter-current aur hormonal mechanisms se control hoti hai.
blocks.explanation:
A. Counter-current mechanism:
Loop of Henle aur collecting duct se pani wapas lene ke liye nephrons medulla ke aas paas ke maaye mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada concentration banate aur qaim rakhte hain.
1. Descending limb se pani guzarta hai, namak nahi: filtrate neeche jate hue pani namkeen maaye mein nikal jata hai.
2. Ascending limb se pani nahi guzarta magar yeh Na+ ko active tor par bahar nikalta hai; Cl- peechhe chalta hai. Is se aas paas ka maaya namkeen rehta hai.
3. Dono limbs mein bahao ulti simt (counter-current) mein hai, is liye medulla ki gehrai mein namak zyada rehta hai.
4. Peshab jab is namkeen maaye mein se collecting duct mein neeche aata hai to pani osmosis se nikal kar vasa recta ke zariye khoon mein chala jata hai; peshab gaarha ho jata hai.
B. Hormonal mechanism:
1. ADH (antidiuretic hormone): hypothalamus banata hai, posterior pituitary chhorta hai. Pani ki kami ya namkeen khane ke baad hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors khoon mein zyada namak pakarte hain; pyaas lagti hai aur ADH nikalta hai. ADH collecting duct ki deewaron ko pani ke liye zyada permeable banata hai; zyada pani khoon mein wapas aata hai aur gaarha (hypertonic) peshab banta hai. Namak kam ho to ADH band, kam pani wapas, patla peshab. ADH ki kami se diabetes insipidus hota hai (bohat zyada patla peshab).
2. Aldosterone: adrenal cortex se; blood pressure ya khoon mein sodium kam ho to nikalta hai. Distal tubule aur collecting duct par asar kar ke Na+ ka reabsorption barhata hai; pani bhi peechhe khoon mein jata hai. Yeh K+ ka ikhraj bhi barhata hai (hyperkalaemia se bachata hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein 'counter-curent' chhapa hai; durust lafz 'counter-current' hai (counter-current mechanism, 14.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the causes and treatments of kidney stones.
Kidney ki pathri (kidney stones) ki wajoohaat aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kidney (urinary) stones sakht, qalmi (crystalline) maadni zarre hain jo jur kar kidney ya peshab ki naali mein chhoti 'kankariyan' bana lete hain; yeh kidney mein reh sakti hain ya peshab ke raaste nikal sakti hain.
Wajoohaat:
1. Calcium oxalate ki pathri (taqreeban 70% mareez): hypercalciuria (peshab mein zyada calcium) aur hyperoxaluria (peshab mein zyada oxalate).
2. Uric acid ki pathri (taqreeban 10%): hyperuricemia (khoon mein zyada uric acid).
3. Peshab mein cystine (kitab mein 'cysteine' chhapa) aur phosphates ki zyada miqdaar.
4. Musalsal pani ki kami (dehydration) pathri ka imkaan barhati hai.
Tashkhees: peshab ka test qisam batata hai (tezabi peshab: calcium oxalate; alkaline: calcium phosphate; hamesha tezabi: uric acid).
Ilaj: lithotripsy yani pathri torna:
1. Extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy (ECSWL): lithotripter jism ke bahar se shockwaves bhejta hai jo pathri ko chhote tukron mein tor dete hain; tukre peshab mein nikal jate hain.
2. Percutaneous nephrolithotripsy (PNL), bari pathri ke liye: kamar se kidney tak tube dali jati hai; nephroscope (chhota camera) pathri dikhata hai; ultrasound ka aala usay torta hai aur tukre pakar kar bahar nikale jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain in detail the mechanism and problems related to dialysis.
Dialysis ka tareeqa-e-kaar aur is ke masail tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Renal dialysis kidney failure ka woh ilaj hai jis mein metabolic fazle masnooi tareeqe se khoon se chhaane jate hain. Do qismein:
1. Haemodialysis: khoon ko jism se bahar dialyzer mein ghuma kar fazle nikale jate hain; dialyzer ek filter hai jis mein semipermeable (cellulose) membrane hai. Aam tor par baazu ki artery mein catheter dala jata hai; khoon dialyzer se guzarta hai jis mein khaas maaya dialysate bhi hai. Dialysate fazle, pani aur namak ko membrane ke paar khoon se kheench leta hai; saaf khoon doosre catheter se vein mein wapas jata hai.
2. Peritoneal dialysis: pet ki andaruni jhilli peritoneum istemal hoti hai. 1.5-2 litre dialysate catheter se pet mein dal kar 4-6 ghante rakha jata hai; peritoneum ki capillaries se fazle aur faltu pani is mein aate hain; phir isay nikal kar phenk diya jata hai. Yeh din mein kai dafa hota hai.
Masail:
1. Khoon tak rasai se infection ka khatra.
2. Haemodialysis mein low blood pressure (hypotension) aam hai.
3. Namak ki tabdeeli se muscles mein khinchao (cramps).
4. Khoon ki kami (anaemia), thakan aur kamzori.
5. Bohat jaldi zyada pani nikle to dehydration ya low blood pressure.
6. Jazbati bojh: pareshani, udasi (depression), ilaj ke bojh tale dabna.

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe the principles and the problems associated with kidney transplant.
Kidney transplant ke usool aur is se jure masail bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kidney transplant aik operation hai jis mein na kaam karne wali kidney ki jagah donor ki sehatmand kidney lagai jati hai; yeh aakhri darje ke kidney failure mein kiya jata hai.
Usool:
1. Mareez aur donor ka ehtiyat se jaiza, matching aur nigrani.
2. Blood group, tissue type aur immune system ki matching.
3. Donors: rishtedar donor (walidain, behan bhai, aulad; behtareen); ghair rishtedar donor (shohar/biwi, dost, saathi; blood group aur tissue type milein to kamyab); wafat shuda donor (marne ke baad aaza dene ke liye registered, blood group, tissue type aur immune matching se).
4. Rejection rokne ke liye immunosuppressant dawaiyan.
5. Kidney dene se donor ki sehat ya umar par koi khaas lambi muddat ka khatra nahi.
Masail:
1. Rejection: mareez ka immune system nayi kidney ko ghair samajh kar hamla kar sakta hai, dawaon ke bawajood bhi.
2. Infections: dabaya hua immune system infection ka khatra barhata hai.
3. Immunosuppressants ke side effects: high blood pressure, wazan barhna, infections aur cancer ka zyada khatra.

blocks.prompt:
1. Hypothesize kidney stone by studying the urine test of relevant patients.
Mutaliqa mareezon ke peshab ke test se kidney stone ka andaza (hypothesis) lagayein.
blocks.explanation:
Doctor peshab ke test se pathri ki qisam pehchante hain:
1. Tezabi (acidic) peshab (zyada calcium aur oxalate ke saath, hypercalciuria aur hyperoxaluria): calcium oxalate ki pathri (sab se aam, taqreeban 70%).
2. Alkaline peshab (zyada phosphate ke saath): calcium phosphate ki pathri.
3. Hamesha tezabi peshab (zyada uric acid; khoon mein hyperuricemia): uric acid ki pathri.
4. Peshab mein zyada cystine: cystine ki pathri.
Bohat gaarha peshab (pani ki kami) in sab ki taeed karta hai. Chapter se aage: microscope mein peshab ke crystals aur peshab mein khoon bhi pathri ki nishani hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the importance of kidney donation for the benefit of kidney failure patients.
Kidney failure ke mareezon ke faide ke liye kidney donation ki ahmiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Kidney donation aakhri darje ki kidney beemari wale ke liye zindagi bachane wala tohfa hai; transplant khoi hui kidney ka kaam wapas deta hai.
2. Mareez baar baar ke dialysis aur us ke masail (infection, low BP, cramps, khoon ki kami, jazbati bojh) se azad ho jata hai.
3. Rishtedar donor behtareen match deta hai; ghair rishtedar aur wafat shuda donors se kidneys ki tadad barhti hai aur zyada mareezon ka transplant hota hai.
4. Donor ek kidney ke saath normal zindagi guzarta hai; tehqeeq ke mutabiq us ki sehat ya umar par koi khaas lambi muddat ka nuqsan nahi.
5. Marne ke baad aaza dene ke liye register hona doosron ki madad ka zariya hai.
Chapter se aage: donation razakarana aur qanooni ho (aaza ki khareed o farokht nahi), registered transplant centres ke zariye.

blocks.prompt:
3. Name the important kidney transplant centres in your city.
Apne shehar ke ahem kidney transplant centres ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh project wala sawal hai: har talib-e-ilm apne shehar ke centres ki fehrist hospitals, akhbaar ya internet se banaye.
Chapter se: Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT), Karachi, Pakistan ka pehla kidney transplant centre (1985); Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center (PKLI&RC), Lahore (2017).
